answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying influence to a costly, recurring bond instead of to the count of identities. Each agent must restake a small deposit on every heartbeat pulse; identities that stop paying wither like unwatered trees in an orchard. Trust then flows along edges weighted by locked capital, so a forger seeking a high-degree vertex in the graph must stake a fortune, and slashing burns it the moment fraud is detected.
